newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia scored warm weather in 1996-bureau.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia scored warm weather in 1996-bureau.

text.p: The average temperature over Australia during 1996 was the fifth highest on record, the Bureau of Meteorology said in a statement on Friday.
Australia's average temperature in 1996 was 0.46 degrees celsius above the average for the 1961 to 1990 period and 0.65 degrees above the average for 1910-1996, the bureau said.
Warm temperatures were not uniform over the continent with the warmest conditions across the sub-tropics, particularly in winter. The southeast was cooler than normnal for much of the year, it said.
Recent years had been exceptionally warm with more than half of the top 20 warmest years since 1910 coming in the 1980s or 1990s, it said.
Australia's warmest year was in 1988 when temperatures were about 0.7 degrees above the 1961-1990 average, it said.

A feature of the warming trend over Australia, and much of the world's land areas during the second half of the century, had been a tendency for overnight minimum temperatures to have increased more than daytime maximum temperatures, it said.
